name: knapsack
description: 0/1 Knapsack dynamic programming solver that selects items to maximise total value within a weight capacity.
aiPromptContext: Use this block when you need to select a subset of items with weights and values to maximise value without exceeding a weight budget, such as resource allocation, budget optimisation, or cargo loading.

parameters.name: capacity
parameters.description: Maximum total weight the knapsack can carry.

parameters.name: items
parameters.description: Array of items, each with {weight: number, value: number, name?: string}.
